verdict.rationale: Render is a cloud application platform, so managed, globally distributed AI inference is a fair capability to ask about. The evidence pack shows no serverless inference API or managed GPU offering. Adjacent items do not deliver the story: managed OIDC only authenticates services to Anthropic and OpenAI, and the global CDN only serves static assets.

support.subject: As an ai-native builder, I can run AI model inference globally with a single call without managing GPUs or capacity planning
